name: Hitozuma Onee-san to Tsundere Osananajimi no Haranda Kankei
original_name: 人妻お姉さんとツンデレ幼なじみの孕んだ関係
source:
Kouki has two old friends, Yukiko and Rio. When he was a university student, Yukiko got married and left the town.... However, she is back to the town now. Kouki still loves Yukiko and his pent-up sexual desire explodes. Rio, who loves Kouki, notices it and approaches him in various ways....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090108001413/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1010684]ErogeShop[/url]]
